integrity: Proof is symbolic for arbitrary parameters and accompanied by independent exhaustive facet-based checks for 49 finite parameter pairs; every bundled file is byte-counted and SHA-256 hashed.
scientific_limitations: Only first simplicial doubles of joins of two unfilled cycles of lengths at least four are classified. The quotient is by the factor-preserving dihedral product, not necessarily the entire simplicial automorphism group. Unindexed equivalent results may exist; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Parity components and a contractible symmetry quotient in doubles of joined polygon boundaries
